jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP for Banking Good to have skills : NA Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education We are looking for experienced SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking professionals to join our banking transformation programme. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working on SAP Banking solutions within the banking domain, preferably across implementation, configuration, integration, migration or production support engagements. SAP Core Banking is an industry-specific solution for banking clients, with key capabilities across Deposits Management, Business Partner, Loans Management and Payments. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply, with preference given to candidates who have worked across multiple SAP Banking modules and have strong banking domain knowledge. Key SAP Banking Areas The candidate should have experience in one or more of the following: 1. Deposits Management (DM) Current Accounts and Savings Accounts Term/Time Deposits Banking product configuration Account opening and lifecycle management Interest calculation and processing Charges, fees and related account operations Deposit product migration and conversion Integration with Business Partner and Payments 2. Business Partner (FS-BP) SAP Financial Services Business Partner Customer / Business Partner creation and maintenance Business Partner roles and relationships Customer data migration BP integration with Deposits, Loans and Payments Understanding of customer lifecycle processes 3. Loans Management (LM) Retail/Commercial lending products Loan account lifecycle Loan creation and disbursement Repayment and payment schedules Interest and charges Loan closure/payoff Loan product configuration and migration Integration with Payments and Business Partner 4. Payments / Payment Central / Payment Engine Payment processing and payment lifecycle Payment initiation and processing Payment routing and distribution Payment exceptions and investigation Payment-related configuration Integration with core banking and external payment systems Understanding of domestic/international payment flows Key Responsibilities Work with business and technology teams to understand banking requirements and translate them into SAP Banking solutions. Configure and support SAP Core Banking functionality based on business requirements. Participate in end-to-end SAP Banking implementation and transformation programmes. Support product configuration across Deposits, Loans, Business Partner and Payments. Analyse existing legacy banking processes and support their migration to SAP. Support data migration, reconciliation and validation activities. Work on integration between SAP Banking modules and external banking applications. Analyse and resolve functional issues, defects and production incidents. Support SIT, UAT, regression testing and production deployment activities. Work closely with technical teams on interfaces, APIs, integrations and batch processing. Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios and operational documentation. Participate in design discussions and provide banking domain expertise. Support release planning, implementation and post-go-live activities. Collaborate with distributed teams across business, technology, vendors and banking stakeholders. Required Skills Must Have: Hands-on experience in SAP Banking / SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking. Strong understanding of banking products and processes. Experience in at least one of the following: Deposits Management Loans Management Business Partner / FS-BP Payments / Payment Engine / Payment Central Experience in SAP Banking implementation, migration, configuration or production support. Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking components. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with business and technology stakeholders. Preferred Skills Candidates with experience across two or more of the following will be preferred: SAP Deposits Management SAP Loans Management SAP Financial Services Business Partner SAP Payment Engine / Payments SAP Transactional Banking / TRBK SAP Banking Services Banking product configuration Legacy-to-SAP banking migration Large-scale banking transformation programmes Retail Banking / Corporate Banking Account and customer migration Banking payments and settlement processes Banking Domain Experience Candidates should have a good understanding of one or more of the following banking processes: Current and Savings Accounts Term Deposits Customer / Business Partner lifecycle Loans and lending products Account opening and closure Interest and fee processing Payments and payment processing Account migration Customer migration Product migration Banking reconciliation Payment exceptions and investigations Integration & Technical Exposure Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking and surrounding systems is desirable. Exposure to the following would be advantageous: APIs / Web Services REST / SOAP Enterprise integration Banking middleware Batch processing Data migration tools Database / SQL SAP integration frameworks Legacy banking platforms Payment systems Experience in Transformation / Migration Experience in large-scale banking transformation programmes will be highly valuable, particularly: Legacy banking platform SAP migration Customer and account migration Deposit product migration Loan migration Payment migration Data reconciliation and validation Application decommissioning Parallel run / cutover Production deployment and hypercare Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a SAP Banking specialist with strong banking domain knowledge, rather than a generic SAP consultant. Qualification 15 years full time education 10-12 Yrs account opening, business requirements, banking solutions, batch processing, data migration, banking products, banking domain, banking

Must have skills : Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary: We are looking for a Bluetooth/Wi Fi Developer to design, integrate, customize, validate, and maintain the Bluetooth and Wi Fi software stack for an Automotive Android (AOSP) based In Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) Head Unit. The role requires strong system-level Android connectivity expertise, including driver/HAL integration with a 3rd party chipset vendor, and ensuring automotive grade performance, stability, interoperability, and compliance readiness. Key Responsibilities: 1.AOSP Connectivity Stack Development Integration 2.Lead bring up and integration of Bluetooth/Wi Fi stack components on Automotive Android OS, aligning with chipset firmware/driver deliverables from the hardware vendor. 3.Integrate and customize Android connectivity interfaces including Vendor HAL, Supplicant HAL, and Hostapd HAL, and support transitions across interface mechanisms (AIDL/HIDL) as applicable to the Android baseline. 4.Work across Android build and tooling workflows (source sync, build, debugging) and use Android developer utilities for diagnostics and triage. 5.Feature Enablement Use Case Implementation: 6.Enable core Bluetooth/Wi Fi functions and implement IVI specific connectivity features/use cases across the program lifecycle. 7.Support multi display / multi user or high integration scenarios where connectivity must work reliably across concurrent user contexts 8.Design and Develop Bluetooth and Wi-Fi based Audio/Video Streaming solutions. 9.Collaborate with platform/system teams to resolve end to end integration issues between connectivity subsystem and the overall IVI platform. 10.Quality, Validation Certification Readiness 11.Drive validation, debugging, and optimization for range/throughput performance, stability, and coexistence behavior in automotive environments. 12.Ensure readiness for Android platform compatibility expectations including support for annual Android upgrades and CTS/CDD compliance where applicable. 13.Support certification readiness activities aligned to Bluetooth SIG and Wi Fi Alliance (WFA) programs (working with test teams/labs and providing engineering support for defects found during qualification). 14.Security, OTA, and Lifecycle Maintenance 15.Implement and maintain secure connectivity behaviors (e.g., secure pairing, encryption expectations) and support OTA update strategies, including firmware/stack patching and lifecycle updates. 16.Own defect triage and long term maintenance, including root cause analysis for complex system issues spanning framework HAL driver firmware boundaries. Professional Technical Skills: 1.Strong hands on experience in Android platform/AOSP development with system-level debugging across framework/services and native layers. 2.Strong Bluetooth fundamentals: architecture, profiles, common use cases, and Android Bluetooth stack understanding. 3.Strong Wi Fi fundamentals: modes/standards (STA/AP, Wi Fi Aware/RTT concepts) and Android Wi Fi architecture understanding. 4.Experience integrating Wi Fi HAL surfaces (Vendor/Supplicant/Hostapd) and familiarity with AIDL/HIDL patterns in Android. 5.Experience with A2DP, ARCVP, HFP/HSP, BLE GATT/GAP. 6.Understanding of RTP/RTSP, TCP/UDP, Multicast/Unicast Streaming, DLNA/Miracast/AirPlay/Chromecast concepts. 7.Proficiency in C/C++ and Java (Kotlin beneficial for some Android system components). 8.Strong debugging skills using Android/system tools (logs, platform diagnostics) and ability to work in low power / constrained environments. 9.Work closely with chipset vendor, system integrator, and internal stakeholders to align interfaces, resolve integration blockers, and ensure continuous integration of the stack into the IVI platform. 10.Experience with Bluetooth qualification tooling (sniffers/PTS) and supporting SIG qualification workflows. 11.Experience with Wi Fi certification processes, test labs, or automation harness expectations. 12.Exposure to coexistence/interference mitigation and RF/performance issue triage in complex environments. 13.Exposure to Bluetooth Audio Codecs. 14.Knowledge of network performance tuning and latency optimization. 15.Experience supporting Android platform upgrades and compatibility requirements (CTS/CDD alignment). Additional Information: 1.The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions. 2.A 15 years full time education is required. jobs.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description BETSOLs team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. Key responsibilities Testing SAM publisher implementations Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. Building and running test automation Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. Quality process and reporting Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. Qualifications Required qualifications Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. Preferred qualifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus. Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based). Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports. Hands-on experience developing production-grade backend applications using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. Strong understanding of LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, context management, embeddings, structured outputs, function calling, and tool integration. Hands-on experience implementing RAG solutions and integrating vector databases. Experience integrating LLM applications with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and external tools. Understanding of agent evaluation, observability, tracing, monitoring, and AI guardrails. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Foundry. jobs.title: Data Engineer - I
jobs.description: About GoKwik GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands-from checkout optimisation and reducing return-to-origin (RTO) to payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000+ merchants globally and processes approximately $2B in annual GMV. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, we are building AI-powered infrastructure to enable faster, smarter commerce outcomes. Why This Role Matters As a Data Engineer I, you will build and maintain data pipelines that power GoKwiks analytics, machine learning models, and business-critical applications. You will work with modern data engineering technologies, including Apache Iceberg, Trino, Spark, and Kubernetes, while developing a strong understanding of distributed data systems and platform engineering. This role goes beyond traditional ETL development. You will be expected to understand the systems behind the pipelines, ensure data correctness, optimise query performance and cost, and use AI tools effectively while validating the quality of their output. You will progressively expand your ownership into data platform engineering, orchestration, infrastructure, real-time data serving, and governance. What Youll Own Data Pipeline Development & Management Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines, from source ingestion and schema definition to production-ready silver and gold data models. Develop reliable and reusable data transformation workflows using SQL, Python, Trino, and Spark. Implement incremental data processing, MERGE operations, and idempotent jobs to ensure consistent and efficient data delivery. Onboard new data sources and migrate legacy pipelines to standardised data processing frameworks. Work with structured and semi-structured data across multiple source systems. Data Quality & Reliability Implement data quality checks, validation rules, deduplication logic, and safeguards for edge cases. Reconcile transformed data against source systems to identify discrepancies and ensure accuracy. Build monitoring and alerting mechanisms to detect data issues before they affect downstream applications and reporting. Ensure data pipelines are reliable, maintainable, and resilient to failures. Document data models, dependencies, and data quality requirements. Performance & Cost Optimisation Analyse and optimise SQL queries and distributed data processing jobs for performance and cost efficiency. Understand partitioning, data layout, query execution, and resource utilisation to improve processing efficiency. Identify inefficient queries, unnecessary data scans, and bottlenecks across the data pipeline. Apply best practices for working with large-scale datasets and distributed processing systems. Production Support & Problem Solving Investigate production issues across data pipelines and downstream data consumers. Conduct root-cause analysis to identify underlying problems and implement long-term fixes. Collaborate with Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science teams to resolve data-related issues. Participate in code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. Data Platform Engineering Develop an understanding of data orchestration, infrastructure, and deployment workflows. Contribute to platform improvements involving Kubernetes, GitOps, and cloud infrastructure. Explore real-time data serving and analytical systems using technologies such as Apache Pinot and ClickHouse. Support data governance, documentation, and standardisation initiatives. Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while independently validating generated code, queries, and logic. Who You Are Have 1-3 years of experience building data pipelines or data platform systems. Strong internships and relevant projects may be considered for candidates at the entry level. Have strong SQL skills and the ability to debug queries, investigate discrepancies, and reason about data correctness. Possess solid Python programming skills; experience with PySpark is an advantage. Have hands-on experience with at least one distributed data processing or query engine, such as Spark, Trino, or Hive. Understand data warehousing and lakehouse fundamentals, including facts and dimensions, partitioning, incremental loads, and data modelling. Have a strong debugging mindset and the ability to identify root causes rather than relying only on temporary fixes. Are comfortable writing tests, participating in code reviews, and following software engineering best practices. Can communicate technical issues clearly and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Use AI development tools to improve speed and productivity while validating their outputs for correctness, performance, and reliability. Demonstrate curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn modern data platform technologies. Why GoKwik At GoKwik, youll work on a modern data platform that supports critical business decisions, machine learning models, and merchant-facing products. In this role, you will lead the integration and optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create conversational travel agents that can understand, recommend, and assist travelers across platforms. LLM Performance Optimization: Tune models and workflows to balance performance, scalability, latency, and cost across diverse environments. Backend Development: Develop scalable, asynchronous backend services using FastAPI or Django, with a focus on secure and efficient API architectures. Database & ORM Design: Design and manage data using PostgreSQL or MongoDB, and implement ORM solutions like SQLAlchemy for seamless data interaction. Cloud & Serverless Infrastructure: Deploy solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure using containerized and serverless tools such as Lambda and Cloud Functions. Model Fine-Tuning & Evaluation: Fine-tune open-source and proprietary LLMs using techniques like LoRA and PEFT, and evaluate outputs using BLEU, ROUGE, or similar metrics. NLP Pipeline Implementation: Develop NLP functionalities including named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, and dialogue state tracking. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, frontend developers, and product teams to ship impactful features rapidly and iteratively. Preferred Candidate Profile: Experience: Minimum 2 years in backend development with at least 1 year of hands-on experience working with LLMs or NLP systems. LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with tools and libraries such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Database Knowledge: Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance optimization. Model Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), and evaluation metrics for language models. Cloud Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and building serverless or containerized deployments. NLP Understanding: Solid grasp of NLP concepts including intent detection, dialogue management, and text classification. Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate business problems into AI-first solutions with a user-centric approach. Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming concepts and a willingness to learn modern software development practices. During the internship, you will work on real-world projects, collaborate with experienced developers, and gain hands-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and deploying applications. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining web or mobile applications. Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues. Participate in code reviews and team discussions. Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and business teams. Work with databases, APIs, and version control systems. Learn and implement industry best practices and coding standards. Prepare technical documentation as required. Required Skills Basic knowledge of Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, or C++ . Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript , and basic web development. Familiarity with SQL/MySQL or any relational database. Basic understanding of Git/GitHub . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Eagerness to learn new technologies. Preferred Skills Knowledge of React, Angular, Node.js, .NET, Java Spring Boot , or Python frameworks . Basic understanding of REST APIs. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS , Azure , or Google Cloud is a plus. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodology. This job posting has been aggregated from external source.
